key_numbers.label: Refugees in Democratic Republic of the Congo, 2025

explainer.counted: Refugees from the Republic of the Congo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on 31 December 2025, as reported to UNHCR.
explainer.type: A stock: people present at the end of the year, not the number who arrived that year.
explainer.not_included: Asylum seekers, people never registered, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate. UNHCR adds a footnote to this figure.

key_numbers.label: Share of all refugees from the Republic of the Congo

explainer.counted: Refugees from the Republic of the Congo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a share of all refugees from the Republic of the Congo in every host country on 31 December 2025 ({n0} of {n1}).
explainer.type: A share: one year-end stock divided by another, both from the same source.
explainer.not_included: People displaced inside the country of origin, and people counted under other groups.
explainer.reliability: Reported to UNHCR, often by the host government. The data does not say, row by row, whether a figure is a government count, a registration count or an estimate.
